rows.business: I am a habitat gardener who regularly returns to Lassell Research.
rows.greeting: The station can make enough noise for both of us. I’m Remy Ekwueme-Pham. Welcome to Deepwatch lounge.
rows.profileNote: Speaks softly enough that people lean in to listen. Keeps a drawer of orphaned keys for locks long since replaced. Uses understated humor when a shift gets difficult.
rows.personalDetail: Outside work, Remy Ekwueme-Pham enjoys designing tactile maps for visitors.
